label: emptycurve
notes: Convex empty-cell value curve replaces the linear 340 x countEmpty. Aimed straight at the measured cause of death: P(death within 100 moves) at 4 reservoirs is 39% at 3 empties and 78% at 0, while the linear term prices the 3rd-from-last empty like the 12th. Free at run time (one indexed load instead of a multiply). Headline metric: MEDIAN MOVES. PAIRED with baseline.json — same seeds, same depth.
